slides.title: Setting Up a New Account
slides.text: Setting Up a New Account From registration to a ready-to-talk device, step by step

slides.title: Before we start
slides.text: Before we start What makes Bravo different  Two interfaces Separate Tap and Scan experiences, each built for its user  Expressive mascots Engaging characters, not plain stick figures  Wake Word Partners start a conversation just by speaking  Consent-first AI Personal suggestions, with parents in control

slides.title: Roadmap
slides.text: Roadmap The setup at a glance Create the account Login → Register Device setup: 10 steps Interface Mode Mascot Wake Word Button Layout Menu Options User Language Partner Voice Age & Consent Personalized Learning Profile Interview Highlighted: child protection steps. For users under 13, steps 9 and 10 unlock only after a parent consents.

slides.title: Create the account
slides.text: Create the account Start at the login screen New to Bravo? Tap Register here .

slides.title: Create the account
slides.text: Create the account Register, with sharing built in Therapist/Admin email: an SLP can manage the account without sharing the login I am a therapist: this account can access client accounts Allow Bravo Admin: Bravo can help with support

slides.title: Step 1 of 10 · Interface Mode
slides.text: Step 1 of 10 · Interface Mode Built for two kinds of users Tap: a touch-based picture grid Scan: automatic scanning with a switch or key

slides.title: Step 1 of 10 · Interface Mode
slides.text: Step 1 of 10 · Interface Mode One app, two purpose-built screens Tap Scan

slides.title: Step 2 of 10 · Choose a Mascot
slides.text: Step 2 of 10 · Choose a Mascot Characters with real expression Bobby, Bonnie or Buddy , or no mascot at all Expressive and engaging, not plain stick figures

slides.title: Step 3 of 10 · Wake Word
slides.text: Step 3 of 10 · Wake Word Start a conversation by name Interjection + name = “hey Bobby” Then ask the user a question or share a comment

slides.title: Step 4 of 10 · Button Layout
slides.text: Step 4 of 10 · Button Layout Size the grid to fit the user Pick buttons per row and number of rows Fewer buttons = bigger targets Dynamic row: AI keeps generating options

slides.title: Step 5 of 10 · Menu Options
slides.text: Step 5 of 10 · Menu Options Choose the built-in menus Every menu comes with a ready-made board Uncheck a menu to hide it Things has sub-menus, from Clothes to Tools

slides.title: Step 6 of 10 · User Language
slides.text: Step 6 of 10 · User Language The language the user sees Sets the words on buttons, labels and speech history Includes Spanish, French, Arabic and more

slides.title: Step 7 of 10 · Partner Language & Voice
slides.text: Step 7 of 10 · Partner Language & Voice The voice everyone hears Can differ from the on-screen language Child or adult, female or male voices Tap Test Voice to hear it first

slides.title:  Built to protect children
slides.text:  Built to protect children For users under 13, a parent consents before Bravo learns anything about them.

slides.title: Step 8 of 10 · Age & Parental Consent
slides.text: Step 8 of 10 · Age & Parental Consent Under 13? A parent decides. Select Under 13 Enter the parent’s email and tap Send Email

slides.title: Step 8 of 10 · Age & Parental Consent
slides.text: Step 8 of 10 · Age & Parental Consent The request is on its way The button turns green and reads Sent Tap Next and keep setting up

slides.title: The parent’s view
slides.text: The parent’s view Clear promises, one tap to confirm 1. The consent email 2. After tapping Confirm consent No selling data, no training AI models, no ads Consent can be withdrawn at any time

slides.title: Step 9 of 10 · Personalized Learning
slides.text: Step 9 of 10 · Personalized Learning Check for consent in real time Parent confirms, you tap Check for Consent Setup continues, no restart needed

slides.title: Step 9 of 10 · Personalized Learning
slides.text: Step 9 of 10 · Personalized Learning Parents control what Bravo learns Unlocks only after consent Auto-approve: facts added automatically Require approval: review each fact first

slides.title: Step 10 of 10 · User Profile Interview
slides.text: Step 10 of 10 · User Profile Interview A profile for more personal options 15 short questions, about 5–10 minutes Unlocks only after consent Skip now, run later from User Information

slides.title: Setup complete
slides.text: Setup complete Ready to talk  Account registered  Device set up in 10 steps  Parental consent on record

title: Why Does Bravo Have 2 Different Interfaces?

slides.title: Why does Bravo have 2 different interfaces?
slides.text: Why does Bravo have 2 different interfaces? A deeper look at Tap and Scan

slides.title: The starting point
slides.text: The starting point One interface can’t serve every user Other AAC apps interface, usually designed for direct-select users Bravo interfaces, each built for how its user communicates

slides.title: Two design goals
slides.text: Two design goals Flexibility and efficiency Tap · ultimate flexibility Scan · ultimate efficiency

slides.title: Tap vs. Scan · Selecting
slides.text: Tap vs. Scan · Selecting How an option gets chosen  Tap The user taps an option on the screen.  Scan The user usually presses a switch. Tapping the screen works too.

slides.title: Tap vs. Scan · Selecting
slides.text: Tap vs. Scan · Selecting The auditory scanning loop 1 · Highlight Option is read to the user, usually on a personal speaker 2 · Decide Does the user press the switch? 3 · Announce Spoken aloud on the system speaker Next option Bravo moves on and highlights it Yes No

slides.title: Tap vs. Scan · Building a message
slides.text: Tap vs. Scan · Building a message Building blocks or whole phrases Tap: building blocks I want go park Choose individual words or small phrases Scan: phrases I want to go to the park Select a more developed phrase in one choice

slides.title: Tap vs. Scan · The grid
slides.text: Tap vs. Scan · The grid Flexible grid, basic grid Tap: choose exactly how many options to show. Enough to choose from, never overwhelming. Scan: a simple grid. The count matters less, because options are scanned.

slides.title: Tap vs. Scan · Images
slides.text: Tap vs. Scan · Images Pictures on, pictures off Tap Images by default Turn them off for users who can read the options. Scan Text by default Turn images on for users who like to watch the screen.

slides.title:  In both interfaces
slides.text:  In both interfaces Wake Word works everywhere A partner asks a question, and Bravo generates options to respond.

slides.title: Summary
slides.text: Summary Tap and Scan at a glance Tap Scan Designed for Ultimate flexibility Ultimate efficiency Selecting Tap the screen Switch, or tap the screen Strategy Building blocks: words, small phrases Developed phrases Grid Flexible: exact number of options Basic: count matters less Images On by default, can turn off Off by default, can turn on Wake Word Yes

slides.title: Scan interface tour
slides.text: Scan interface tour The Scan screen, part by part Title Lock Speech History Speech Options Status Message

slides.title: Scan interface tour
slides.text: Scan interface tour Title, Lock and Status 1 Title: the page you’re on, like Home or Greetings 2 Lock: opens the Admin toolbar. Default PIN 1234 . 5 Status: what Bravo is doing right now

slides.title: Scan interface tour · 3
slides.text: Scan interface tour · 3 Speech History Shows every option that has been selected and announced. Clear Empties the box Copy Copies options for texting or email Maximize Bigger text, readable from a distance

slides.title: Scan interface tour · 4
slides.text: Scan interface tour · 4 Speech Options Illustration: the orange outline marks the option being scanned Set by the Admin, or generated by AI AI options show and read a short summary Selected: Bravo announces the full option A navigation target opens that page

slides.title: Tap interface tour
slides.text: Tap interface tour The Tap screen, part by part Home button Speech History Message tools Boards Static options Dynamic options Lock

slides.title: Tap interface tour · 1 and 2
slides.text: Tap interface tour · 1 and 2 Home and Speech History 1 · Home Returns to the Home board 2 · Speech History Shows the message being built. Tap it to announce it.

slides.title: Tap interface tour · 3 Message tools
slides.text: Tap interface tour · 3 Message tools Editing the message 1 · Clean Up AI makes the message conversational without changing the idea want park → I want to go to the park 2 · Backspace Removes the last option added 3 · Clear Empties the Speech History

slides.title: Tap interface tour · 3 Message tools
slides.text: Tap interface tour · 3 Message tools Preview, History and word forms 4 · Preview First tap plays at 50% volume. Tap again to announce at full volume. 5 · History Recent messages to announce again or copy 6 · Past tense see becomes saw 7 · Plural toy becomes toys

slides.title: Tap interface tour · 4
slides.text: Tap interface tour · 4 Boards Tap a board to switch to it. Some have sub-boards. Scroll the strip to see more boards Boards button shows them all on one screen

slides.title: Tap interface tour · 5 and 6
slides.text: Tap interface tour · 5 and 6 Static and dynamic options Static: defined on the board Dynamic: purple outline, AI predicts the next option More Options: next page of static options, fresh dynamic ones Selecting announces it, and may open another board

slides.title: Tap interface tour · 7
slides.text: Tap interface tour · 7 Lock and Status Lock Opens the Admin toolbar. Default PIN 1234 . Status message Shows what Bravo is doing, including what it hears when the Wake Word is active
